definition: to send for someone to do a job
description: On a sandy beach at sunset under a pink and orange sky, a tall young man in a black T-shirt and white shorts stretches one arm out and waves someone over. A smiling young woman in a mustard top and navy track trousers comes towards him barefoot, pulling on her jacket. He turns and points towards the game, and she walks after him with the jacket in her hand. People play football by the sea behind them, a brightly painted wooden boat lies on the sand and a white wall with a lamp post runs along the right.

de.answer: Er winkt sie zu sich her.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Le está haciendo señas para que se acerque.
